audit.why: Poppy has no reliable 2v2 all-in before 6; Milio's Q knockback and E shields win the early lane, matching win rate 50.42% and packet levelChart (Milio through L5, Skill at first item).
Key spikes: Milio E at level 3 (2 charges of shield insurance), Milio R at level 6 (cleanses Poppy's E/R CC chain), and first item (W range zone compounds burn).

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-4,6].side all said 'Skill' while the matching content win[0-4,6] already said 'Milio', a page-facing contradiction. Also the missing-interaction (Poppy's R channel is untargetable, dodging timed burst) wasn't stated.
audit.why: regression-check.js fails champions whose full/content layers disagree per matchup; the untargetable-R fact changes all-in timing against her ult.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0,1,2,3,4,6].side to 'Milio' with rewritten .why grounded in each level's kit facts, matching win[]. Added the untargetable-R detail into spikes[1].text.
